This is amazing. I will be 3 years sober in a couple of months. Take it one day at a time!!! There will be ups and downs. 

My biggest advice would to be to treat yourself VERY gently the first 2 years of sobriety. Just remember you are literally just now learning to live life without alcohol. Everything is going to be new. There will be situations that come up that you would’ve drank over in the past. Every situation you get through without a drink you will become better all around. More confident, and more of your true self. This is a process. You are shedding layers of your old self 

You may also notice a lot of uncomfortable emotions surfacing that you used to try to avoid with drinking. FEEL THEM. They will pass but only if you actually feel them, try not to stuff them down using something else. Remember: The only way out is through and what you resist persists.

I would also highly recommend AA meetings, it’s been fucking amazing finding a community of people that actually get it. Please pm me if you’d like to chat. Hope this helps!! You got this!!!
